name: Model comparison

subjectOf.text: Reputation as venture capital must be distinguished from the capital replacement enabled in decentralized underwriting, because in venture capital reputation needs to fill the role of capital for each funded venture deal rather than only when a claim is filed.
subjectOf.abstract: reputation in venture capital needs to fill the role of capital for each funded venture deal.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, REPUTATION AS CAPITAL – How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Address Shortcomings in the Ventu (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3962614
scope_conditions: comparison of decentralized underwriting and venture capital DAOs

subjectOf.text: Model 3, web3 community governance combined with decentralized data and the AI model, is the superior of the three governance models compared, because it addresses shortcomings the other two leave in place.
subjectOf.abstract: Yet, Model 3: "Web 3 Community Governance - Decentralized Data - AI Model" stands out for several reasons, potentially offering a superior approach when compared to the other two models.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714

assumes a functioning web3 community governance layer

subjectOf.text: Quantum economics models must be subjected to empirical testing and to rigorous head to head comparison with classical models across different economic contexts and datasets before their validity and generalizability can be established.
subjectOf.abstract: Another important implication of the debates surrounding quantum economics is the need for more empirical testing and validation of quantum economics models.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
